program_schema.contract_context: nb1-program-effect/v1; Program JSON itself has no contract field

step.color: required #RRGGBB, uppercase accepted and normalized lowercase; no names/hex3/rgb8/hsv

program_schema.timing: sum(fade_ms+hold_ms+10)*repeat <=86400000; native I/O, preflight/finish cleanup add time
program_schema.semantics: Sequential per Step: Set then fade+hold+10 wait; no paired overlap. repeat repeats all steps. Raw RGB, no implicit gamma.
program_schema.capabilities: Preview requires set/program/raw-rgb and hold if requested. Legacy submit validates payload/runtime state/policy but does not universally re-enforce Preview capability list.
program_schema.finish: off or hold only after final step; cancellation/execution errors force off cleanup; active terminal after Stop+Read success, cleanup failure=failed.

shape.frames: 1..1024 Frame, every targets array has same LED set AND order as initial
shape.repeat: HTTP: 1..10000 when present; omitted defaults1; explicit0 rejected; also total executed frames<=1024
shape.on_finish: HTTP: off|hold when present; omitted defaults off; explicit empty rejected

frame.targets: required; same count/order as initial; each led/color required

frame_schema.timing: Initial once; repeat frames only; targets sequential with10ms spacing; shared frame interval, not wait fade per LED; late scheduler does not catch up; tail waits actual last Set return+fade+10; no periodic Read during frame schedule.
frame_schema.preview_timing: host-nominal-excludes-native-io; nominal init=count*10; nominal tail=max(0,(lastTargetCount-1)*10+lastFade+10-lastInterval). USB/OS/cleanup add time.
frame_schema.admission: FrameService required; cached online profile must advertise set/raw-rgb/mk2-basic; no MK3 physical qualification. Current Frame helper checks these three names; hold appears in preview requirements but helper does not itself add a separate hold check.
frame_schema.wire_vs_go_defaults: DecodeFrameProgram rejects explicit repeat:0 and on_finish empty; Go typed NormalizeFrameProgram may fill these zero defaults. Do not copy typed zero-default semantics into HTTP schema.
frame_schema.public_policy: raw Frame HTTP and high v2 HTTP require explicit reject + original full ticket; separate Pattern v2 HTTP now admits frozen frames with explicit replace/queue/reject without changing these legacy routes.

effect_schema.meaning: Legacy two-effect compiler, distinct from eight-action high API
effect_schema.steady: kind,color:#RRGGBB,led(default0),fade_ms(optional0); no cycles/period_ms/on_finish; generates one-step hold Program
effect_schema.pulse: kind,color:#RRGGBB,led(default0),cycles(default1,1..10000),period_ms(default1000,60..1200000 multiple10),on_finish(defaultoff); fade_ms forbidden; compact 3-step symmetric cycle
effect_schema.color: raw hex6 only; newer high pulse attack/decay/rest is a different API

color_boundary.high_and_resolve: ColorInput supports CSS frozen name,hex3/hex6,rgb8 object,hsv object; high actions reuse this parser
color_boundary.low_program_frame_effect_set: hex6 #RRGGBB only; convert through resolve_color first if needed
color_boundary.hsv: {space:"hsv",h_deg,s_pct,v_pct}; h0..360 and s/v0..100; ordinary nonnegative decimal <=6fractional places; no exponent/negative zero; deterministic one-time quantization
color_boundary.unsupported: alpha/HSL/rgb() strings/transparent/currentColor/CSS vars/Chinese aliases/random; no implicit gamma

job_and_receipts.frame_job: FrameJob replaces step counts with completed_frames,total_frames,completed_target_writes,planned_target_writes; id prefix framejob_
job_and_receipts.identity: daemon_ +32lowerhex per Engine; request_id=req_<positive Engine uptime deadline>_<32lowerhex random>
job_and_receipts.receipt_semantics: same serial/key space for Program and Frame; cross-kind key reuse conflicts; same accepted payload returns current original Job, never reruns; active pinned; terminal retention expires independently of ordinary history; no restart persistence
job_and_receipts.uncertainty: 202/accepted is admission only. POST timeout/bad response does not prove no execution; keep original ticket, only GET original receipt. 404/410/restart do not authorize automatic new POST.
job_and_receipts.cancel: Cancelling active waits native completion and worker cleanup; queued cancel can finish immediately without Set. Terminal succeeded hold does not extinguish when cancelled. Native I/O has no universal hard deadline.

strictness_notes: All routes share loopback Host/same-origin Origin, no-store,nosniff. No authenticated public/cloud API or CORS relaxation.

Strict JSON decoders reject unknown/duplicate/null/trailing fields; newer Action/Frame/Pattern codec additionally preserves nested numeric/Unicode grammar. Do not generalize every newest codec guarantee to all legacy routes.

New Light/Frame/Color/Pattern routes reject query including empty ? where code checks ForceQuery; several old root/job routes do not uniformly reject query/body. Prefer documented canonical paths; this inventory does not claim missing guards are implemented.
GET state is cached and may be stale while frame runs; latest sampled_at is evidence. Desired target, successful Job, readback and optical capture are different facts.
OpenAPI file at these baselines is older v1 subset; do not treat it as complete inventory.
P6 POST4096B all closed ASCII fields; standard JSONSchema cannot prove raw surrogate/duplicate/byte budget or source hashes.
Pattern query requires four exact scalar fields and zero body/empty separators; query/cancel zero Store/config dependency.
